correctness.rationale: Reassessed the repaired card-weighted finding and its two credited comparisons. Independent rational enumeration of just the mixed one-break pattern X,L,Y, with an intact opposite packet L, gives card-weighted departure masses (5/32,1/4,5/32) and confirms all 36 entries of the generator at rate 9/64. The same enumeration gives 7/48 and 7/16 for the comparison rules. The repair proves directed rate equality via the stabilizer of a given cyclic order, rather than relying only on transitivity on unordered pairs. At q=0 all rotations have positive probability within each class, all laws are bounded and the complementary subspace contracts; summing its O(rho^k+q) contribution multiplied by q plus the O(q²) one-step error gives O(q) on bounded rescaled intervals. This justifies the lifted Euler limit for t>0. Opposite-pair antisymmetric and centered symmetric modes give rates 4a and 6a, respectively, and the initial class has the only positive mass deviation. Nonincreasing finite-q distance and strict profile crossings yield the asserted mixing thresholds. The comparison ratios are a_B/a_C=28/27 and a_I/a_C=28/9.
residual_risks: Frozen checker at lines 143–149 verifies no mass outside rotation classes at q=0, not positivity for every within-class transition. The proof establishes positivity directly. Finite diagnostics alone do not establish the asymptotic, nor is the limiting profile a claim at t=0.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: At four cards the generator support is octahedral and symmetry produces rates lambda_4/4 and 3 lambda_4/4. Diagonalizing that six-state matrix gives exactly the frozen two comparison profiles, not new claims. Card weighting requires the different conditional factor (|X|+|Y|)|L|/(4(|L|+|Y|)); Jiang's bounds and the two-rule generator do not give the resulting 9/64 or its profile as their case.

value.rationale: At the smallest deck giving this six-state orientation quotient, the release mechanisms can share a generator shape and divergence order while their precise clocks differ. The card-weighted rate provides a meaningful model comparison not resolved by the existing order bound or by the all-deck two-rule result: the exact small slowdown by 28/27 against block release is visible, and the limiting profile determines all positive slow-scale time thresholds rather than one finite-q statistic.
residual_risks: Four cards, positive rescaled times and thresholds below 5/6 only. No general card-weighted deck-size limit or finite-q exact time change is asserted.
